questions.text: Explain the organic weathering.
questions.text_as_printed: Explain the organic weathering. (A)

answer.value:
Biological Weathering:
Biological weathering occurs when rocks are broken down by plants, animals, and human activities.
It involves both physical and chemical processes.
Roots of plants growing and thickening, burrowing animals, mining, and construction activities contribute to biological weathering.

questions.text: Justify how human activities play a major role in causing the natural disasters.
questions.text_as_printed: Justify how human activities play a major role in causing the natural disasters. (D)

answer.value:
Human Activities Causing Natural Disasters:
Population growth leads to increased pressure on natural resources.
Industrialization and urbanization degrade the environment.
Deforestation, excessive rainfall, and drought disrupt ecosystems.
Mining alters the Earth's surface.
Environmental pollution, including land, water and air pollution, exacerbates natural disasters.
These human activities increase the frequency of natural calamities.

questions.text: Suggest precautionary measures to prevent the adverse effects of earthquakes.
questions.text_as_printed: Suggest precautionary measures to prevent the adverse effects of earthquakes. (D)

answer.value:
Preventing Earthquake Damage:
Issue early warnings about potential earthquakes.
Keep residential areas away from earthquake-prone zones.
Construct earthquake-resistant buildings.
Stay safe indoors during an earthquake.
Avoid living in hazardous areas.
Stay cautious near windows, glass or walls during an earthquake.
Avoid damaged bridges and roads post-earthquake.
